configuration.T1: Initial block only, later block zero; same allocated parameter capacity
configuration.T2: Initial and actually acquired later blocks; same question/option exposure as its information-ignored T1 control
configuration.T3: Same T2 family fitted with original R4 admitted training episodes versus all raw-role-admissible R5 training episodes; identical held cohorts and loss normalization
configuration.budget: Question and exposed-option costs inherited from actual trace; T1 information-ignored matched-budget control also reported at initial-only cost; final comparison not observed, actual cost zero and NOT_EVALUATED
configuration.evaluation: Frozen R3 matching implementation with full T and no exclusion of A; fixed hidden subset full T minus source A exact reported separately
configuration.features: Two fixed binary canonical-selection blocks, Q0/Q1 then later newly selected concepts; no coffee, grader, source, future answer or T feature
configuration.group_scope: Original coffee dependence folds; shared graders, source and sometimes preparation categories; no participant/cross-source/general-product confirmation claim
configuration.learning_curve: Deterministic hash-selected complete training groups at 50 and 100 percent, same held groups
configuration.loss: Coffee-macro mean positive-mention cross entropy + 0.1/2 squared coefficient norm; unpenalized intercept, target positive frequencies normalized per record over fixed representable positives; OOV retained in evaluation
configuration.negative_control: Rotate complete acquired-B feature bundles across training groups within source/condition/record-count strata; singleton strata unchanged and counted; no formal permutation p-value
configuration.scaling: No fitted scaling: binary canonical selection; duplicate evidence once
configuration.selection: One configuration; no tuning by old five trigger cases or held losses
configuration.trigger_gate: Inspect actual new-Q3 information and independent positive groups in each outer training fold; no new fit if any has zero or support remains concentrated; diagnostics cannot authorize more complex routing

data_supervision.A_B_T_independence: Disjoint original grader-row IDs; shared coffee/session and repeated global graders remain dependent; blinding unverified; CROSS_GRADER_CORROBORATION
data_supervision.alternate_mapping_role: FROZEN_R1_EXACT_LEXICAL_PARSER audit comparison only, not selected for training or evaluation
data_supervision.context: Missing production C0/C1 masks context effects only, not sensory-task eligibility; source roast/grind literals retained privately, never fabricated production C1
data_supervision.formal_examples: build_examples requires root's frozen JSON to embed proposal() exactly and specify mapping_choice before data become a training input
data_supervision.full_reference: All positive fine concepts from T rows, including concepts also expressed in A or B; T-grader mention frequency; no target grader inside input consensus
data_supervision.grouping: Original sample IDs join actual grader rows; normalized coffee names reuse exact old D0 group; same-name samples remain one group; anonymous samples are unresolved possible prior overlap and not independent new coffees
data_supervision.historical: All 526 rows were parsed or inspected in R1; old17 and prior R4 rows are historical development, never fresh confirmation
data_supervision.mapping_guard: No new exact term, compound split, parent-child equivalence, source-label reclassification or target-based mapping choice
data_supervision.numeric_reference: Three existing source-native ordinal intensity fields, ranks0..4; report reference grader distributions/masks, no interval-average target unless separately registered; zero means low, not absence
data_supervision.observation_unit: One actual source sample x named grader row, all seven descriptions and scores attached to that row; fields do not become independent people
data_supervision.quality: Seven source quality score columns remain excluded from sensory-intensity supervision
data_supervision.roles: Fixed existing global grader-hash order, first actual grader row=A, second=B, all remaining=T; do not drop a grader because lexical mapping is empty; no role rotation
data_supervision.unexpressed_reference: Separate fixed subset of full T excluding only A exact fine concepts; do not delete siblings, do not update the subset as questions reveal B

information.I1: Actual current-bank Q4 ASK selections; positive-text nonmention corrected to UNSURE in all R5 branches
information.I2: One existing-axis scheme: train-coffee-macro B coverage doubled for current A shared attribute, deterministic tie; same question/option budget, no current B/T choice
information.I_FULL: Keep I0 encoded A and add all actual B positive observations; same scorer, diagnostic outside budget; no source A unselected expansion
information.context: Fixed synthetic legal C0/C1 engineering context for description-source simulations, NOT observed production context or C0/C1 effect estimation
information.effect_margin: No new noninferiority gate; historical0.02 remains operational, not user acceptance
information.legacy: R4 negative/nonmention behavior preserved as history, not repeated in R5 input
information.nested: Each training row uses its inner-held question expert excluding the entire outer-held groups; no OOF-only shortcut
information.oracle: Posthoc best legal ASK/SKIP only diagnostic, never deployable
information.scorer: Existing isolated A0 R1 outer and R2 inner base experts wrapped by unchanged R4 A0

information_protocol.I1: Actual frozen current-bank Q4 ASK trajectory
information_protocol.I2: Same Q0/Q1; choose unused registered correction axis maximizing train-group mean B coverage, doubled for current A shared attribute; deterministic axis tie; exact I1 slot option budget; never current B or T for question choice
information_protocol.I_FULL: Initial selected A retained plus complete source B positive evidence batch; outside product question/option budget, no inferred unmentioned negatives
information_protocol.answer_limit: Positive-text source nonmention becomes UNSURE, never sensory absence; legacy NONE_OF_THESE conversion count retained; T never supplies answers
information_protocol.gain: Fixed A0 SKIP gap minus ASK gap, ties retained, empty T null
information_protocol.independence: Coffee held out; shared graders; static cross-grader corroboration, not sequential human QA
information_protocol.target: Full independent fixed T; separately fixed T minus source A exact

new_sources: Admission and any new task require typed identity/rights/measurement record before fit; predefined hash split for genuinely new groups, no effect-driven admission
product: B2 default; FOUNDATION_CHECK off; C0 eight/C1 seven required; ASK_Q3 or SKIP_Q3 to Q4; Q4/Q5 endpoint; one actual3–8 final comparison; main<=5 secondary<=3
rights: Source-specific restrictive intersection noncommercial research, private raw data and weights; publication rights separate

supervision.A: First real grader row in frozen R4 global grader order, even if its strict mapped concepts are empty
supervision.B: Second distinct real grader row, even if strict mapping empty
supervision.T: All remaining distinct grader rows; positive mention frequencies, full fixed T retains concepts also present in A
supervision.cohort: Named existing source samples with >=3 original grader observations; old95 development sample scope retained, old17 history separate; anonymous source identities excluded from cross-grader task
supervision.hidden_T: Full fixed T minus exact source A concepts; never updated after B
supervision.increment: Recover task-usable raw-role records dropped by nonempty mapped-grader rule; count as new task pairs, not new independent coffees or collection
supervision.mapping: Frozen strict D0 governed concepts; source-native ordinals audited separately, no quality/liking substitution
supervision.reference_limits: Shared coffee/session, unverified blinding, shared graders across coffee folds; no personal sensory truth
supervision.roles: Raw observation-unit isolation, not required conceptual disjointness; no role rotations
